scope: The default-transport full-node job was cancelled after water/PPPM became extremely slow. A full log audit found UCX errors in eight of its 12 completed timings and in all four water numerical gates. It is not a passed full experiment. This table uses only its four completed, error-free SNAP points whose CPU/GPU numerical checks passed. The paired run uses the same image, inputs, physical GPU UUIDs and CPU affinity, but excludes CUDA IPC. Measurement order and time differ, so this is diagnostic evidence, not a randomized causal trial.
